actions.reason: Use the native TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR contract, with a tool-independent cache under the existing shared cache root. No filesystem link.
actions.risk: Tool-specific configuration, locks, permissions, or concurrent writes may invalidate the plan.
prerequisites: Confirm target is expected and writable
Stop the owning tool when required
verification: Recheck original file SHA256 and mtime_ns against audit; stop on drift.
Copy only the verified o200k_base cache to a previously absent directory; compare SHA256 against upstream expected hash.
Run the actual tiktoken package in an isolated staging verification environment; block network reads and load o200k_base, then verify Chinese/English encode/decode round-trip.
Cold-load cl100k_base from the official public encoding URL and verify its new cache file and expected hash at the new target.
Launch a fresh child with the approved new setting, repeat offline loading, and prove the original cache snapshot is unchanged.
actions.rollback: Restore previous user/process TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR. Retained original cache remains immediately usable; do not delete the new target automatically.

actions.reason: Future processes inherit the native shared cache path.
actions.risk: Existing application processes retain their old inherited environment until restarted.
prerequisites: Authorize the exact user environment variable and filesystem targets through the applicable execution path
verification: Set the explicit child environment for immediate checks
State restart requirement for existing applications
actions.rollback: Restore user TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR to ${DATA_ROOT}/codex/cache/tiktoken; no machine-level setting changes.

actions.reason: Use a temporary isolated verification environment because tiktoken is absent in the three checked interpreters; do not install into unrelated environments.

verification: Run the actual offline warm-cache and real cold-cache tests, not a mocked replacement library
actions.rollback: Restore previous cache setting on failure; retain original files. Remove only newly owned staging after successful use if permitted; never bypass a cleanup rejection.
